exceptions.packages: Distribute the actual npm plugin and release tarball; no placeholder container/app-store package.
exceptions.wiki: Versioned guides are authoritative; do not create duplicate empty Wiki content.
exceptions.projects: Issues and PRs own the current backlog; an enabled tab is not a populated board.
exceptions.publishing: No new release credential or trusted publisher is provisioned.
exceptions.progress: Use real releases, checks, issues and Stars; a new repository has no meaningful Star History until actual activity exists.
exceptions.website: README and versioned guides are the current user path; a new standalone website requires a separately approved visual overview.
